assets.name: cursor-turn-poses
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE functional fantasy game cursor sprite sheet: exactly EIGHT poses in a precise FOUR-column TWO-row grid of equal SQUARE cells, requested1536x768. First input is legacy cursor evidence, second input is approved style only. Every cell contains the SAME polished sapphire-blue circular lens/disc with a thin dark-blue/silver rim and a simple gold RIGHT-pointing triangular arrow at its centre. Consistent body size, centre, height, lighting and camera in every cell; about70% cell width. Front-facing fantasy interface icon, broad simple forms, readable at16x16 logical pixels; no filigree, text or extra ornaments. TURN/SHIMMER variant, row-major pose order0..7: keep the sapphire disc fully open in all poses. The gold triangular arrow narrows horizontally to suggest a vertical-axis turn: full width, three-quarter width, half width, narrow edge, half width, three-quarter width, full width, full width. The arrow always points RIGHT, no direction reversal. A subtle blue glint moves across the disc; outer circular silhouette must stay identical. True transparent alpha outside each cursor, generous empty gaps, all eight cells occupied. No backdrop or painted checkerboard, no grid lines, no labels or numbers, no external glow or shadows. Do not draw different designs, extra objects or poses. This is one eight-frame sprite sheet.
